findings.why_it_is_a_defect: A new model is constructed during body reevaluation while the child only observes the injected instance, so state and task lifetime can reset.
findings.recommended_change: Retain a stable parent-owned instance with SwiftUI-owned state, or make the child the explicit owner; do not construct it inline.
findings.authority_or_scope_note: Confirmed from the supplied call site; intended per-item lifetime is unknown.

controls_not_defects: @ObservedObject is valid for one stable parent-owned injected instance.
unknowns: Whether the model persists across item changes is unspecified.
